essayTitle: Senawang Grand Mall: A Shopper's Paradise
source: SPM 2026 Trial · Negeri Sembilan · English Paper 2 · Part 3 Q4 · Review, 200–250 words
paragraphs: Are you looking for the perfect place to spend your weekend? Last Saturday, I visited a shopping mall that exceeded all my expectations, and here is my honest review.

The name of the shopping mall is Senawang Grand Mall. It is located just off the main highway in Senawang, Negeri Sembilan, which makes it easily accessible by car and bus. Ample parking spaces are available for visitors.

The mall offers a wide range of facilities for shoppers of all ages. Apart from more than 200 retail outlets, there is a cinema, a bowling alley and a spacious food court serving local and international cuisine. Young children will love the indoor playground. Furthermore, the services provided are excellent. The friendly customer service counter offers free wheelchairs and baby strollers, and the toilets are spotlessly clean.

I would definitely recommend this shopping mall to others. Firstly, it is a one-stop centre where families can shop, dine and be entertained under one roof. Secondly, it frequently holds attractive promotions during festive seasons. Shoppers can enjoy great bargains without breaking the bank.
In a nutshell, Senawang Grand Mall is a shopper's paradise that caters to every need. If you have not visited it yet, it is high time you did!
